Arafat Minhas to Sonny Baker, out Gus Atkinson Run Out!! 1 run completed. A direct hit from Arafat Minhas and think Gus Atkinson is OUT - the 3rd umpire isn't needed and Pakistan win by 87 runs. An awful mix-up draws curtains on the game for England. Was tossed up on middle and drifted onto the pads - flicked in front of square on the on-side and they completed the first run. The fun then started - Gus Atkinson was rushing back for the second, Sonny Baker started and then turned back, the throw was at the bowler's end. Minhas grabbed and dropped the ball, Gus Atkinson tried to rush back - but Minhas recovered quickly, collected the ball and threw down the stumps at the striker's end, catching the batter well short. Gus Atkinson run out (Arafat Minhas) 7(5) [4s-1]

20:24 Local Time, 15:24 GMT, 20:54 IST: A chase that started so brightly has ended in complete disaster for England. Ben Duckett (45) and Tom Banton (57) added 91 at better than run-a-ball. The tourists were cruising until the former top-edged a pull off Haris Rauf. It then became a slide as Arafat Minhas came to bowl. Having already made a 50 with the bat, he took that confidence to the ball and simply outclassed the Englishmen. Banton pulled a short ball to mid-wicket, Harry Brook was left surprised by the turn which opened him up completely, Jordon Cox was trapped in front. Jamie Overton and Will Jacks holed out while Adil Rashid was also trapped in front. In between, Naseem Shah and Haris Rauf gave their team the advantage by dismissing Joe Root and Sam Curran. It was a total team effort and Pakistan have taken a big step towards reaching the October 31st final. Stay tuned for the presentations..

Harry Brook | England Captain - (On the target) We were quite happy with 300. We thought they were probably slightly under par. It got dewy, as we thought it would do, but yeah, we were pretty happy at halfway. (Not capitalising on the start that Banton and Duckett provided them) Yeah, that was the story of the innings, really. We thought Bants and Ducky set the tone beautifully to nearly get a hundred partnership, and then it was just a case of losing too many wickets in clumps. We couldn't really string any partnerships together and, yeah, we ended up on the wrong side. (On the importance of getting back to winning ways) Definitely, you always want to win, don't you? We've spoken a lot about rotation of strike through the middle, but I think we were probably a little bit too careful against the spinners, especially. We can probably put them under a little bit more pressure in stages, and, yeah, we've got tonight to talk about it and tomorrow and bounce back better on Thursday.

Two wins out of two and Mike Hesson's Pakistan team is on a roll. They've a break now with England and Sri Lanka taking on each other in Rawalpindi's final match of the tri-series. That's on the 22nd and we'll be back for all the action. For now, cheers and bye..
